newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian telecoms surge after Svyazinvest sale.
newsitem.headline: Russian telecoms surge after Svyazinvest sale.

text.p: Shares in Russian telecoms companies rose 10 percent and more on Monday after the government sold a 25 percent stake in the Svyazinvest holding company on Friday for a higher than expected $1.875 billion.

At 1200 GMT long-distance operator Rostelekom was $5.47 after closing on Friday at $.4.90, but was off a day's high of $5.67. It was the day's most active share on the Russian Trading System, with $10 million of stock changing hands.
Moscow phone company MGTS jumped to a day's high of $2.30 from Friday's $2.03, and St Petersburg provider PTS was $2.80 after $2.33.
